_meta: Change rationale for v2-rewrite. Each case maps to an array of {tag, note} entries.

apex.note: Empty decorative primary banner (full-width colored rect with no text)
Focal KPI: "6 pts" discount gap as hero number with inline context
Quote cards now asymmetric — left uses accent bar + tinted bg, right uses tinted group — breaking visual sameness
charSpacing section headers ("KEY FINDINGS", "CUSTOMER DISCOUNT & MARGIN COMPARISON")
Pattern analysis text between table and callout — explains the discount inversion, not just shows it

cascade.note: Single-element slide (model-specific rule): chart filled 75% of canvas with only a summary bar below
Three KPIs at top: +70.5% Energy growth, 27% Energy mix share, −13.2% Private Label decline
Chart reduced from full-width to 60% — freed right 35% for a "Quarterly Trends" insight panel
Color-coded legend bars in trends panel — each series gets a colored rect + narrative sentence
Summary strip now states the organizing idea (revenue base transformation) instead of listing raw numbers

halvorsen.note: Replaced triple-card grid (3 identical rounded-rects for Manual Overrides / Stale Competitive / Freight)
Proportional stacked bar — bar widths reflect actual data (61% / 24% / 15%), making the concentration visible
Focal KPI: "$31.7M" as hero number with inline "top 3 = 39.4%" context
Callout is now actionable: quantifies the recovery ($7.6M) from fixing top-3 manual overrides

isb.note: Replaced triple-card grid (3 identical rounded-rects: Pricing Strategy / Servicing Model / Deployment Mix — generic text, no real data)
Comparison table: 5 rows of structured Factor / Merchandiser / ISB data replacing vague prose cards
Focal hero text inside each group: "Higher" / "Lower" at 28pt with subtitle — immediate visual anchor
charSpacing section headers ("EQUIPMENT COST COMPARISON", "KEY CONSIDERATIONS")
"Best for:" conclusion line in each group — makes the trade-off decision explicit
Strategic callout strip: frames the decision as volume-per-location, not which-is-better

logistec.note: charSpacing section headers ("BUSINESS MODEL", "RECENT LEADERSHIP") — replaced with plain bold labels
Descriptive table label: "New Leadership Team (Post–Take-Private)" — contextualizes why the table matters
Footer callout: "Blue Wolf took LOGISTEC private... entire C-suite replaced within 18 months" — ties the leadership table to the take-private thesis
Composition largely preserved — baseline was already strong (4 KPIs + 2 filled groups + table)

meridian.note: Narrative header between bookend EBITDA figures: "+$12.1M net gain (+14.0%)" with "driven entirely by price realization"
Vertical accent bar separating FY24 figure from the narrative — visual pause
Callout expanded to two lines: headline (price realization offset) + supporting detail (counterfactual: EBITDA would have fallen to ~$55M)
Waterfall bridge composition preserved — already a strong custom build from rect primitives. 8pt labels on small bars flagged by engine but match baseline

sow-extension.note: Replaced triple-card grid (3 identical team member cards: Maik Ardan / Edward Mabuyo / Jonathan Cook)
Team & pricing table: 4 columns (Member / Role / Rate / Allocation) — tabular data belongs in a table
Scope bars compressed from h:0.08 to h:0.06 with tighter gaps — freed vertical space for the table
charSpacing section headers ("SCOPE", "TEAM & PRICING") — replaced with plain bold labels
